activity: Work at the studio on planting plans, coordination, and site-visit follow-up.
Eat a simple lunch and take a short quiet break.
Continue studio work, meetings, and site-related coordination.
Make the call to my parent or older relative about the health, appointment, or future-arrangement concern, listening carefully and taking notes.
Travel to the ceramics class and have a small snack if needed.
Attend the second ceramics class and work slowly through the exercises, allowing the pieces to be imperfect.

Handle restaurant prep, deliveries, and kitchen management. I check produce and temperatures, organize the prep list, speak with the manager, portion ingredients, and keep an eye on the Friday service setup.

Take a short staff meal and reset in the kitchen, drinking from my thermos and reviewing the evening notes. I make a few practical adjustments to the prep list rather than starting new menu experiments.
Change into a fresh work shirt, check the final service notes, tuck any receipts into the restaurant notebook, and prepare the kitchen for the evening rush.
Work dinner service and closing duties. I coordinate the line, taste sauces, manage tickets, finish the last cleanup, and lock up after the rush has fully cleared.
